core_obligations: Statement (lines 3132-3148): in the pushout situation X = Z coprod_{Z'} X' with Z = Spec(k') for a field k' and Z' = Spec(k'_1 x ... x k'_n) with k'_i/k' finite field extensions, the completed local rings form a fibre product diagram prod k'_i <- prod O_{X',x'_i}^ , k' <- O_{X,x}^ with horizontal arrows given by the maps to the residue fields.

Affine reduction (proof lines 3150-3156): choose an affine open Spec(A) of X containing x and let Spec(A') be its inverse image in X'; by construction the rings form the fibre product diagram prod k'_i <- A', k' <- A.

Completion step (lines 3157-3164): since everything is finite over A, the diagram remains a fibre product diagram after completion with respect to the maximal ideal m of A corresponding to x (Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-completion-flat).
Identification (lines 3164-3169): Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-completion-finite-extension identifies the completion of A', which yields the completed local rings diagram of the statement.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an affine open neighbourhood of the image point x.
Take the ring-level fibre product diagram from the pushout construction.
Complete at the maximal ideal; finiteness preserves the fibre product.
Identify the completed rings of A' via the finite-extension completion lemma.
